summary: Adds keyboard support to the calculator. A new keyToInput helper maps keys to calculator inputs, a global keydown listener feeds those inputs into the existing press flow, and a help note and a test are added.

nodes.label: calculator.js
nodes.description: New exported keyToInput maps keys to calculator input values or null.

nodes.label: app.js
nodes.description: Adds a document keydown listener that calls press() with the mapped value.

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.description: The footer note now shows keyboard hints.

nodes.label: calculator tests
nodes.description: Covers keyToInput mapping and the state machine through keyboard input.

uiStates.title: Keyboard input
uiStates.before: Calculator input only through button clicks.
uiStates.interaction: Press digits, operators, Enter, Backspace, Escape or Delete.
uiStates.after: Keys drive the same calculator input flow as the buttons.

reviewNotes: Check that event.target.closest exists for every keydown target, since document or window targets lack it.
The regex allows '-' and '/' keys; confirm the default browser behavior of '/' (quick find) is acceptable to suppress.
Enter on a focused button may trigger both the click and the '=' keydown handler.
